Name: Shroom Chicks  (CP and AT)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[b][size=3][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod still works in 1.6(though the CP version needs it's Format updated in the content.json). It will not be updated further though.[/i][/size][/b]

The idea was born long ago in the SDV discord server when someone mentioned mushroom chicken. So I...made some retextures for the brown, white and blue chicken changing them into a red mushroom, purple mushroom and magma cap variant!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher and/or Alternative Textures.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
